answers.core: If leveraging a defined convention to redefine how loading is perfromed, it must be implemented at a core level to perform lookups.  Using something like npm's package.json to define where "sources" or an "index" exists is helpful as well.
answers.workaround: Best solution I've found, since not everyone publishes to the Godot Asset Library, is to use git submodules.  This also allows for handling any modules that a company may keep internal for personal projects.
